entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Make ObsoleteAttributeData public #82356
  • [Hot Reload] HotReloadException race condition #82354
  • `StringSyntax` support for VB and VB-test in C# strings #82352
  • improve CS9293 message to show it's about "static" #82351
    Backlog

Closed

  • Enum extension have lesser priority than static method #82336
  • add direct x12 support for c# #82353
  • Analyzer config option to exclude generated files from BannedApiAnalyzer #82114
    18.4
  • Remove hack in build/Targets/Imports.targets working around project system additional files support #19545
    Backlog
  • Missing sequence points for local functions and lambdas in runtime async #82227
    18.5
  • Deference of possible null reference after checking and returning #82331
  • [11.0.100-preview.1.26104.118] paint.netcore build failed with "Keyword 'this' is not available in the current context" #82314
  • Completion doesn't show extension methods if there is a property with the same name #70537
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix HotReloadException race condition by using AppContext.GetData #82355
  • Re-enable tiered JIT for netcore compiler #82350
    Area-Compilers
  • Adds a listener in the initialize handler for client process exit #82348
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2900558 #82243
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Detect changes in non-Roslyn projects and report them as rude edits #82225
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Extension indexers: avoid assignment to BoundSequence #82296
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • MSBuildWorkspace: Load projects for languages that do not have a known command line parser #82159
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • Remove legacy LSIF (Language Server Index Format) implementation #82235
    VSCode, Next
  • Remove a hack in eng\targets\Imports.targets #82349
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Fix sequence point and instrumentation issues with runtime async #82236
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async, Next
  • Adds --clientProcessId option so server can shutdown when the parent does #82346
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Show both property and extension method items with identical name #82315
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Emit async-iterators with runtime-async when possible #81314
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • `GetDeconstructionInfo` should dig through conversions #82324
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix CFG for interpolation handler in object initializer without setter #82303
    Area-Compilers
  • don't crash the process if the stream disconnects #82316
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Added selection clearing after moving between methods #82284
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Allow specifying diagnostic options for source-generated files #82224
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix embedded source decoding on big-endian architectures #82335
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • LSP 3.18 protocol updates #82294
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Replace linear search with dictionary lookup in Workspace_Editor.GetOpenDocumentSourceTextContainer_NoLock #82342
    Area-IDE
  • Merge branch 'main' into features/UnsafeEvolution #82267
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Run the issue-labeler over pull requests using polling #82333
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2899596 #82319
  • Initial support for non-boxing union TryGetValue access pattern #82325
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
